I implemented `minidb/executor.py`. 13 of the 14 tests in `tests/test_executor.py` pass. `test_insert_reports_no_rows` fails, and I left it that way on purpose.

That test expects `execute_insert` to return `row_count` 0. `test_insert_without_columns_passes_values_through` expects the same call to return 1, and so do the task description, the module docstring and the `QueryResult` docstring. Both tests make the identical call, `execute_insert(InsertStmt("t", None, (7, "z", False)), store)`, so no implementation can satisfy both. I followed the spec (INSERT returns 1). Test files are read-only for me, so I didn't change the conflicting test.
